Appointments & C., by the Governors
1A
UVA PROVINCE PROVINCIAL COUNCIL
Appointments by the Governor of Uva Province

BY Virtue of powers vested to me by Section 32 (1) of the Provincial Council Act, No. 42 of 1987, I, M. P. Jayasinghe,Governor of Uva Province do hereby notify that the following appointments have been approved by me.
01. Mr. H. M. Jeewantha Herath, Grade III officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, to perform, the Duties of

the Secretary to the Ministry of Road Development, Housing, Water Supply, Co-operative, Animal Productionand Cultural Affairs for the Uva Provincial Council, from the date 22.05.2015 to 01.06.2015, till the return of Mr.W. M. M. G. Abesinghe Banda, to the Island who is the Secretary to the Minister of Road Development,Housing, Water Supply, Co- operative, Animal Production and Cultural Affairs for the Uva Provincial Council.
02. Mr. H. P. A. G. Anuruddha, Grade III officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, to perform, the Duties of the

Secretary to the Ministry of Health, Indigenous Medicine, Probation and Childcare, Women's Affairs and Powerand Energy for the Uva Provincial Council, from the date 22.05.2015 to 01.06.2015, till the return ofMr. L. L. Anil Wijesiri, to the Island who is the Secretary to the Minister of Health, Indigenous Medicine,Probation and Childcare, Women's Affairs and Power and Energy for the Uva Provincial Council.
03. Mr. R. M. T. B. Hathiyaldeniya, Grade I officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, to perform, the Duties of

the Secretary to the Ministry of Sports, Youth Affairs, Textiles and Small Industries and Estate InfrastructureDevelopment and Estate Education for the Uva Provincial Council, from the date 22.05.2015 to 01.06.2015, tillthe return of Mr. G. K. S. L. Rajadasa, to the Island who is the Secretary to the Ministry of Sports, Youth Affairs,Textiles and Small Industries and Estate Infrastructure Development and Estate Education for the Uva ProvincialCouncil.

04. Mr. R. B. N. R. Priyashantha, Grade III officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, to perform, the Duties of

the Secretary to the Ministry of Agriculture, Irrigation Inland Fisheries Industry, Land, Tourism Affairs andTransport for the Uva Provincial Council, from the date 22.05.2015 to 01.06.2015, till the return of Mr. GunadasaSamarasinghe, to the Island who is the Secretary to the Ministry of Agriculture, Irrigation Inland FisheriesIndustry, Land, Tourism Affairs and Transport for the Uva Provincial Council.
05. Mr. Sumith Suraweera, Grade I officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, to perform, the Duties of the

Deputy Chief Secretary (Administration) for the Uva Provincial Council, from the date 22.05.2015 to 01.06.2015,till the return of Mrs. R. M. S. D. Rathnayake, to the Island who is the Deputy Chief Secretary (Administration)for the Uva Provincial Council.
M. P. JAYASINGHE,
Governor ofUva Province.
